proposals.subtype: Connection-string/key/token client factory and policy wiring
proposals.explanation: The wrapper distinguishes credentials from options, parses endpoint/connection-string arguments, honors options.baseUrl, constructs the imported generated client, and adds createCommunicationAuthPolicy only for a non-token credential.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: This src wrapper explicitly imports the separately generated factory and adds argument adaptation and conditional pipeline wiring around it.

proposals.explanation: The public factory constructs an event-listener implementation that copies options, overlays nested signaling options with resourceEndpoint and gatewayApiVersion 2024-03-07, and obtains a platform signaling client using the communication credential and logger.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The src listener composes an external signaling client and EventEmitter alongside the generated REST client, providing substantive realtime behavior rather than an ordinary generated REST binding.

proposals.subtype: Realtime start/stop state and local-listener cleanup
proposals.explanation: Start rejects an unavailable signaling client, returns when already marked started, sets the flag before awaiting start, then subscribes signaling handlers. Stop rejects an unavailable client, clears the flag before awaiting stop, and removes local emitter listeners after stop resolves.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The listener implements its own lifecycle flag, platform guards, asynchronous sequencing and emitter cleanup outside the generated REST tree.

proposals.subtype: Guarded local event subscription and removal
proposals.explanation: on rejects an unavailable signaling client and requires started state for events other than the two connection notifications before registering on the emitter. off also requires an available signaling client, then removes the specified emitter listener without a started-state check.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: These concrete listener methods implement state checks and local callback registration around a signaling transport rather than generated HTTP operations.

proposals.subtype: Signaling events forwarded through a local emitter
proposals.explanation: Subscribes to connectionChanged and emits local connected/disconnected notifications for those two states. It also forwards chatMessageReceived, chatThreadPropertiesUpdated, participantsAdded and participantsRemoved payloads unchanged through the local emitter.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The implementation explicitly registers signaling callbacks and adapts them to its own event-emitter API outside the generated REST tree.
